original_image.limitation: This is an unchanged original from Host803a/Native0e261, not a render of the new candidate. The second requested original, 21_lumo_kart_real_race.png, has not been personally viewed by this reviewer.

findings: Both baseline source files were independently fetched at f052 and are byte-identical to their previously reviewed f0c19 blobs.
The previous fixed offsets and recursively scaled map-child minimum are replaced by a deferred fit using settled safe-area, header, message, hint and action rectangles.
The first candidate omitted the full-width centered message row. The reviewer identified that omission; V2 reserves both the actual message and visible jump-hint rectangles.
V2 binds item_rect_changed and visibility_changed for message and jump hint, as well as relevant controls. A hint becoming visible therefore queues layout without relying on a viewport resize.

Candidate rectangles remain inside the safe bounds and below the full visible notices. The fit can only reduce the preferred candidate rectangle; intersecting controls cap its bottom. Candidate right edges are limited to the safe right edge and actual obstacle edges.

All visible header buttons, joystick and pedal actions are considered. Existing action artwork draws at 1.12 times the square hit rectangle; the corresponding 0.06 per-side expansion is verified against the actual drawing source.

Only _build_ui, _apply_responsive_layout and _apply_ui_scale differ among the 142 existing production functions; the remaining 139 are byte-identical. Two layout helpers and one queue flag are added. Driving physics, action behavior and asset references are unchanged.

The new actual-scene contract observes seven density/cutout/viewport profiles, including small portrait, short landscape and restored dense layout. It checks safe bounds, map/content containment and existing controls at least 47.95 dp, with 48 dp as the target.
A single added hint show_for/hide_hint cycle uses the real hint methods, with unchanged window size and no manual layout call, and checks map movement/restoration plus control/notice exclusion.
Removing only the four added test functions, three added report arrays/fields and the new _run call reconstructs the complete previous test source byte-for-byte.

The existing runner still contains exactly 52 probe/mode invocations and executes mobile_safe_area_regression in both headless and rendered modes. The existing raster verifier still requires the original 15 shared controls and four Mobile SafeArea images; new Kart records/captures use separate report fields.
decision: No remaining static blocker found in the two exact V2 blobs. Proceed with the targeted unchanged-test red/green engine run.
